sections.heading: Key Features and Benefits
sections.body:
Four gas burners. Four burners let one cook boil, simmer and fry at the same time, so a full menu comes out together. Cast pot rests hold big pots steady.

Electric oven. The oven below uses electricity, so you can roast and bake without using more gas, and it keeps going on the gas side while the oven runs.

Drop down oven door. A wide door opens flat, so you can slide in heavy trays and baskets and see what is cooking.

Control knobs and indicator lights. Brass knobs give clear control of each burner, and red and green lights on the oven panel show when it is switched on and heating.

Stainless steel body. The surface resists heat, grease and rust and wipes clean after service.

sections.heading: Care and Maintenance
sections.body: Let the oven cool before cleaning, wipe the interior and door seal, and clean burner heads regularly. Keep controls dry.
